method: Read-only source review plus isolated TemporaryDirectory fixtures; no production metadata was refreshed or rewritten.

findings.title: Named generation batches create a phantom unclassified parent
findings.trigger: One explicitly classified batch at assets/library/characters/kangaroo/generation-batches/task-a-f83c containing frames/final.png.
findings.cause: Configured containment is tested after reducing the source file path to the unversioned structural parent.
findings.reproduction: Make the one named batch and PNG in a temporary project; write schema_version:1 config with that root/state=shared_stock; call inspect; see the extra empty unclassified parent.

findings.title: A reservation can commit after the final config hash guard while refresh still reports pass
findings.trigger: Reserve a new batch after refresh checks config_sha256 and before its first os.replace.

observed.subsequent_check: Asset management registry is stale; inspect changes before refresh

findings.expected: Reservation and publication share the config writer lock; either concurrent reservation is rejected or refresh aborts without reporting a current successful snapshot.
findings.cause: Refresh holds registry/index locks, but reserve/release acquire only the independent config lock.
findings.reproduction: In a TemporaryDirectory fixture, patch os.replace to call reserve when destination equals HUMAN_INDEX, then delegate to original os.replace. Refresh passes, but immediate check fails stale.

findings.title: A symlink at the fixed human index redirects publication into source art
findings.trigger: assets/library/character-assets.html is a symlink to an existing PNG inside the project.
findings.expected: Reject a symlink publication path before replacing any file; source art remains byte-identical.
findings.cause: project_path resolves the symlink and refresh then replaces the resolved target as its HTML output.
findings.reproduction: Create an original PNG fixture, point HUMAN_INDEX symlink at it, then call refresh. The PNG becomes the HTML payload.

findings.title: A symlinked reference inside an active batch escapes the pending exclusion
findings.trigger: An active generation batch contains identity-reference.png linking to an existing canonical PNG outside the active root.
findings.expected: All lexical paths below the active writer root are omitted until handoff, regardless of symlink target.
findings.cause: Pending membership is checked using path.resolve(), which follows the link out of the reserved branch; rglob also continues traversing active trees.
findings.reproduction: Patch SCOPES to characters and EXTRAS to []; create active root and symlinked reference; inventory_paths includes the active reference path.
